title: Mouse eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M22 72 Q8 76 10 60 Q12 48 22 52' fill='none' stroke='#f6a1c8' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='66' rx='26' ry='20' fill='#b9c4d6'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='72' rx='16' ry='12' fill='#e8eef7'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='44' r='19' fill='#c9d3e3'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='27' r='10' fill='#f2b6d0'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='27' r='5' fill='#ff8fb8'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='27' r='10' fill='#f2b6d0'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='27' r='5' fill='#ff8fb8'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='57' cy='42' r='3.5' fill='#2a2350'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='42' r='3.5' fill='#2a2350'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='41' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='41' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='53' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#ffd9e6'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='50' r='3' fill='#ff6f9c'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <path d='M80 54 L92 51 M80 56 L92 58' stroke='#e0e7f2' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- arms holding cracker -->
  <path d='M52 62 Q56 54 62 55' stroke='#b9c4d6' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M40 60 Q46 54 54 56' stroke='#b9c4d6' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- cracker -->
  <circle cx='58' cy='56' r='8' fill='#f5c26b'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='53' r='1.1' fill='#d99a3c'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='53' r='1.1' fill='#d99a3c'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='59' r='1.1' fill='#d99a3c'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='59' r='1.1' fill='#d99a3c'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='56' r='1.1' fill='#d99a3c'/>
  <!-- bite mark -->
  <circle cx='63' cy='50' r='3' fill='#c9d3e3'/>
</svg>
